summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing the opening of a new Canna Cabana retail cannabis store in Caledonia, Ontario. The filing contains no special-situation event — no acquisition, disposition, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spinoff, restructuring, or management change. It merely reports a routine store opening, expanding the company's retail footprint. As a foreign private issuer's current report on routine operational progress, this does not trigger any special-situations classification.
